_note: Hover help for this project's buttons, menu items and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is: tab / sub-tab / group box titles (outermost first) or a dialog's title, joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored. An empty text = no tooltip on purpose. Engine controls (developer buttons, Environment tab, OK / Cancel / Close ...) already have entries in Base\Services_ToolTips.psm1; an entry here overrides them. The developer build lists every control still missing one in <data root>\Logs\ToolTips_missing.txt.

ToolTips.Overview: What this tool does and how to run an entry.
ToolTips.Library: Every saved command and function: search, read, run here or on other computers.
ToolTips.Import: Find functions in a project zip, folder or module files and add them to the library (admin).
ToolTips.Library > Run: Open the run window for the selected entry: fill in the values, see the exact command, then run it.
ToolTips.Library > Copy code: Copy the selected entry's code to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Library > Copy example call: Copy an example call of the selected entry to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Library > Reload: Read the library again (picks up entries changed elsewhere).
ToolTips.Library > Stop: Stop the run in progress. Results so far are kept.
ToolTips.Library > Copy: Copy the output to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Library > Export CSV: Save the results of the last run to a CSV file.
ToolTips.Library > New: Add an entry: a command (syntax template) or a function (pasted code).
ToolTips.Library > Command (syntax template): New entry from a command line with {Field} placeholders.
ToolTips.Library > Function (paste PowerShell cod: New entry from a pasted PowerShell function.
ToolTips.Library > Delete: Delete the selected entry from the library.
ToolTips.Library > Runnable here only: Show only entries that can run on this computer.
ToolTips.Library > Search descriptions too: The search box also looks in the descriptions, not only the names.
ToolTips.Run: Run the command shown above. Commands that change things show the command window first.
ToolTips.Copy command: Copy the exact command shown above to the clipboard. Nothing is run.
ToolTips.Check now: Check that this computer (or the targets) has what the command needs.
ToolTips.Set: Enter the credential this value needs. It is never saved.
ToolTips.On: Include this switch in the command.
ToolTips.Run on these computers (remoting): Run the command on the computers listed (PowerShell remoting).
ToolTips.Connect with other credentials: Ask for an account to connect to the remote computers with.
ToolTips.Check the target answers before running: Ping / test each target first and skip the ones that do not answer.
ToolTips.WhatIf - show what would change, change: Add -WhatIf: the command reports what it would change and changes nothing.
ToolTips.Import > Zip: Pick a project zip to read functions from.
ToolTips.Import > Folder: Pick a folder to read functions from.
ToolTips.Import > Files: Pick module or script files to read functions from.
ToolTips.Import > Scan: Read the chosen source and list the functions found. Files are only read, never run.
ToolTips.Import > Show template engine functions: Also list the AppTemplate engine's own functions.
ToolTips.Import > Show blocked: Also list functions that cannot run standalone.
ToolTips.Import > Check all Ready: Tick every new or changed function that is ready to run.
ToolTips.Import > Add checked to library: Add the ticked functions to the library as new entries.
ToolTips.Import > Update changed: Update library entries whose code changed in this source.
ToolTips.Changes things (asks before running): On: the command window always asks before this entry runs.
ToolTips.Can run on remote computers: On: the run window offers to run this entry on other computers.
ToolTips.Analyze: Check the pasted code: functions, parameters and anything that stops it running standalone.
ToolTips.Fill from help: Fill the description and fields from the function's comment-based help.
ToolTips.Add missing fields: Add a field for every {Field} used in the template but missing from the param() block.
ToolTips.Save: Save this entry to the library.
